teaser.en: Its scent is famous in perfume; at the coast its flowers are worn on clothes and in hair, and scattered on beds.
teaser.sw: Harufu yake ni maarufu katika manukato; huku pwani maua yake huvaliwa kwenye nguo na nywele, na hutawanywa vitandani.
teaser.dg: Arufuye inamanyikana sana kpwenye marashi; pwani maruwage nkuvwalwa nguwoni na nyereni, na nkumwagwa vitandani.

summary.en: Mlangilangi is the ylang-ylang tree, an introduced perfume tree whose fragrant, drooping yellow flowers Digo people use as decoration. Its Digo name comes from the English name.
summary.sw: Mlangilangi ni mti wa *ylang-ylang*, mti wa manukato ulioletwa kutoka nje, ambao maua yake ya manjano yenye harufu nzuri na yanayoning'inia hutumiwa na Wadigo kama mapambo. Jina lake la Kidigo limetokana na jina la Kiingereza.
summary.dg: *Mlangilangi* ni muhi wa *ylang-ylang*, muhi mjeni wa marashi; Adigo nkuhumira maruwage ga rangi ya mandano, genye arufu nono na ganayogbwadzika, kudzipamba. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinatuluka kpwa dzina ra Chingereza.

about.en:
*Mlangilangi* is a fast-growing tree with drooping branches and large, glossy, pointed leaves. Its flowers hang in clusters and have six long, narrow, twisted petals that start green and turn yellow as they ripen, when they give off a strong, sweet scent. The fruits are clusters of small dark berries.

Pakia counts it among the plants that Digo speakers can identify from their flowers, because the flowers are valued as perfume.
about.sw:
*Mlangilangi* ni mti unaokua haraka wenye matawi yanayoinama na majani makubwa, yanayong'aa na yenye ncha. Maua yake huning'inia kwa vishada na yana petali sita ndefu, nyembamba na zilizojisokota, ambazo mwanzoni ni za kijani na hugeuka manjano yanapokomaa, na hapo hutoa harufu kali tamu. Matunda yake ni vishada vya beri ndogo nyeusi.

Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea ambayo Wadigo wanaweza kuitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu maua hayo yanathaminiwa kama manukato.
about.dg:
*Mlangilangi* ni muhi unaokula upesi, wenye panda zinazogbwadzika na makodza makulu, ganayong'ala na genye ntsa. Maruwage ganagbwadzika mafungu-mafungu, na chila ruwa rina vibapa sita vire, vyembamba na virivyodzikunja; vinaandza kukala vya chijani na vinagaluka kukala vya rangi ya mandano vichiivwa, na wakati uho ganalavya arufu kali ya mtswano. Matundage ni mafungu ga matunda madide maru.

Pakia anauandika kahi ya mimea ambayo Adigo anaweza kuimanya kpwa maruwage, kpwa sababu maruwage nkuhumirwa dza marashi.

where.en: It is native to South-East Asia and was brought to the Kenya coast for cultivation. Pakia, following Beentje, says it has since gone wild there. Look for it in gardens and around homes.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa Kusini-Mashariki mwa Asia na uliletwa pwani ya Kenya kwa ajili ya kupandwa. Pakia, akimfuata Beentje, anasema tangu hapo umeanza kuota wenyewe porini huko. Utautafuta bustanini na kuzunguka nyumba.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa chienyeji wa Asia ya kusini-mashariki, na ukarehwa pwani ya Kenya kuphandwa. Pakia, achilunga Beentje, anagomba kukala sambi ukamera weruni macheye hiko. Unaweza kuuona busitanini na kanda-kanda ya midzi.

uses.en: The flowers are best known worldwide as the source of ylang-ylang oil for perfume. On the Digo coast, the flowers are made into rosettes and worn on clothes and in the hair, or placed on beds, for their beauty and scent.
uses.sw: Duniani kote maua yake yanajulikana zaidi kama chanzo cha mafuta ya *ylang-ylang* yanayotumika katika manukato. Katika pwani ya Wadigo, maua hutengenezwa kuwa vishada vya mapambo vinavyovaliwa kwenye nguo na nywele, au huwekwa vitandani, kwa ajili ya uzuri na harufu yake.
uses.dg: Duniani kosi maruwage ganamanyikana sana kpwa sababu nkuhenderwa mafuha ga *ylang-ylang* ga kuhenda marashi. Pwani ya Adigo, maruwa nkuhendwa maua madide ga kupambira, ambago nkuvwalwa nguwoni na nyereni, au nkuikpwa vitandani, kpwa sababu ya uzuriwe na arufuye.

culture.en: Pakia describes how flowers are used for beauty and romance among the Digo. Rosettes of *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) and jasmine are worn or laid on beds. Together with henna patterns and flower-pattern fabrics, these beautifications are called *maruwa*, from *ruwa*, a word for beauty.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jinsi maua yanavyotumika kwa urembo na mapenzi miongoni mwa Wadigo. Vishada vya maua ya *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) na yasmini huvaliwa au hutandikwa vitandani. Pamoja na michoro ya hina na vitambaa vyenye michoro ya maua, mapambo haya huitwa *maruwa*, kutokana na *ruwa*, neno la uzuri.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza vira maruwa nkuhumirwa kpwa uzuri na mahaba kahi ya Adigo. Maua madide ga kupambira ga *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) na asmini nkuvwalwa au nkuikpwa vitandani. Phamwenga na mitindo ya hina na nguwo zenye mitindo ya maruwa, mapambo higa gosi nkuihwa *maruwa*, kula kpwa *ruwa*, neno ra uzuri.

names.en: Pakia gives *mlangilangi* as one of three Digo plant names that agree with scientific or Western names. It was adopted from the English *ylang-ylang* when the tree was introduced. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mlangilangi* kama mojawapo ya majina matatu ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayokubaliana na majina ya kisayansi au ya Kimagharibi. Lilichukuliwa kutoka kwa jina la Kiingereza *ylang-ylang* mti ulipoletwa. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mlangilangi* dza dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina mahahu ga mimea ga Chidigo ganayokubaliana na madzina ga chisayansi au ga Chizungu. Dzina hiri rahalwa kula kpwa dzina ra Chingereza *ylang-ylang* wakati muhi uhu urihorehwa. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili kpwenye vitabu.

reason.en: Mkilua, the other perfume flower worn as maruwa
reason.sw: Mkilua, ua lingine la manukato linalovaliwa kama maruwa
reason.dg: *Mkilua*, ruwa ranjina ra marashi rinalovwalwa dza *maruwa*

reason.en: Henna, also part of maruwa beautification
reason.sw: Hina, nayo ni sehemu ya mapambo ya maruwa
reason.dg: Hina, nayo ni seemu ya mapambo ga *maruwa*

reason.en: Wild jasmine, relative of the jasmine worn with it
reason.sw: Yasmini pori, jamaa wa yasmini inayovaliwa pamoja nao
reason.dg: Asmini ya weruni, ndugu ya asmini inayovwalwa phamwenga nao
